values.problem: on a sheet whose subject is a `Product`

findings.message: Review `https://merchant.example/reviews/r-88213` at `$['data']['itemListElement'][0]['itemReviewed']` carries `itemReviewed` on a sheet whose subject is a `Product`.
findings.remediation: Carry `itemReviewed` only where the publisher knows the order line (`order_matched` or `post_purchase_invitation`) and the subject is a `ProductGroup`; otherwise leave it out. It is purchase data, never the author's claim.
